scope.mode: read-only source/header review plus small CPU/meta checks

conclusion: No blocking correctness issue identified within this audit scope; native MPS/full-model quality and CUDA multi-GPU equivalence are outside this CPU audit.

independent_qkv_cpu_test.row_quantization_oracle: Python scalar max(abs(row))/127 clamped to >=1e-12; F32 scales; Python round ties-to-even; clamp [-127,127]

independent_existing_CPU_tests.scope_note: Synthetic CPU/meta storage, pending/retry, identity/alias and synthetic adapter installation; the real adapter was checked by header only.

allocation_formula: MPS payload = official payload - CPU AdaLN - selected BF16 + selected INT8 + F32 row scales + BF16 native row scales. Excludes LoRA, KV, activations, cached AdaLN outputs, allocator reservations and transient/source-page memory.

review_findings.detail: Original modules are allocated on meta, then each parameter is materialized once in its final dtype/device. Parameter aliases are preserved by object identity; state_dict keys stay unchanged. Stream loading copies quantized rows into the existing INT8 Parameter, without replacing it or creating a full BF16 device weight. Plans keep only old meta tensors; nn.Parameter wrapping shares the allocated storage. Allocation failure requires discarding the partial model.

review_findings.topic: CPU AdaLN means staging, not CPU arithmetic
review_findings.detail: All 51 weight/bias pairs start in CPU BF16 storage. After official real LoRA installation and BF16 materialization, fixed actual branch timesteps populate original identity-keyed caches. One AdaLN projection is moved to MPS, evaluated with original BF16 math, synchronized and replaced; unknown future timesteps fail closed. Its CPU payload still counts toward unified RAM until released.

review_findings.topic: Row scratch is not total loader memory
review_findings.detail: The 8 MiB bound applies to quantization row input size; F32 intermediates can consume around five times that amount. Before it, unchanged grouped-QKV reshapes/cat and merged-column full_weight_slice can allocate whole CPU BF16 projection copies. QKV source payload is 231211008 bytes and FC1 is 308281344 bytes; several temporaries and the prior loop value may overlap. Checkpoint mmap resident pages and allocator behavior are additional costs. No exact process peak is inferred from these payload counts.

review_findings.topic: Native W8A16 differs from official CUDA W8A8
review_findings.detail: Selected base weights share the official per-output-row INT8/F32-scale formula. Native Metal consumes BF16 activations and additionally rounds scales to BF16 for aten._weight_int8pack_mm. The dequantize fallback instead uses F32 scales and explicitly rounds reconstructed weights to BF16. These paths are neither bitwise equivalent to each other nor to CUDA W8A8, and this audit establishes no video-quality or long-context parity. FP32 patch/time/final tensors and BF16 LoRA remain outside this 90-matrix quantization.

New allocation branch requires explicit Metal options and MPS device, rejecting simultaneous CUDA load-time W8A8. Pipeline Metal flags default to false/none. CUDA runtime construction does not set them. Distributed linear selects Metal only on the Metal-loaded marker; otherwise the existing CUTLASS-or-F.linear dispatch remains. No CUDA hardware or TP4/TP8 execution was performed during this audit.

All official F32 adapter buffers are first moved to MPS, then materialized one by one as BF16. Initial MPS adapter payload is about 2.31 GiB and final payload about 1.155 GiB; CPU checkpoint pages and each current conversion overlap transiently. This is preserved official adapter behavior, not quantization of the LoRA tensors.

limits: Header comparisons verify inventory, shapes, dtypes and offsets, not checkpoint payload hashes or tensor numeric values. Prior download hash receipts remain the payload-integrity evidence.
Only the full model structure was instantiated on meta; all numeric work in this audit used small synthetic CPU tensors.
The parent runtime experiment and 77-test suite were not treated as independently executed GPU evidence here.
No assertion that W8A16 or INT8 KV preserves official BF16 video quality; full-model/long-run paired evidence is still required.
